Free stand-ins for the Windows system fonts SimGolf asks for by name
(src/port/gdi.c substitutes them):

| Game asks for | Substitute | License |
|---|---|---|
| Arial, Arial Bold | Liberation Sans Regular/Bold 2.1.5 | SIL OFL 1.1 (LICENSE) |
| Times New Roman Bold | Liberation Serif Bold 2.1.5 | SIL OFL 1.1 (LICENSE) |
| Comic Sans MS Bold | Comic Neue Bold (github.com/crozynski/comicneue) | SIL OFL 1.1 |

The game's own fonts (KLEPTO__.TTF, manu3_.TTF) come from the user's install.
